usedFor: Nifty holds projects and tasks, and Freshsales Classic keeps the matching deal current through “Update Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Project Is Created” in Nifty, then “Update Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: When a project starts, the deal can move to its next stage, so sales and delivery agree.

watchOut: Nifty fires many creation events here, so pick one, or “Update Deal” rewrites the same deal repeatedly.
